headline: Swiggy and Groww lead midcap stock purchases by mutual funds in September
hook: September mutual fund flows favour midcaps
summary: Swiggy, Billionbrains Garage (Groww), Patanjali Foods, Astral, and PB Fintech attracted the highest net buying from mutual funds in September, according to a Motilal Oswal report. Swiggy led the inflows with a Rs 6.3 billion value increase during the month. This institutional interest highlights prominent midcap names drawing fresh capital. Indian retail investors tracking institutional accumulation can note these favoured midcap counters.
why_it_matters: Institutional buying supports midcap valuations and price momentum.
winners_losers: Midcap stock holders gain / cautious investors neutral

headline: Patanjali Foods submits AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
summary: Patanjali Foods Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. The filing completes procedural compliance requirements following the shareholder meeting. Indian retail shareholders can review the finalized resolution outcomes on the exchange portals. This is a routine regulatory disclosure with no direct impact on share price.
why_it_matters: No direct consequence for your portfolio.
